title: A great activity in the sunshine
text: Excellent trip, small group and a comfortable boat trip with choice of drinks. Jose provided a very interesting and amusing commentary which included historical facts, a description of the construction of the canal and a brief outline of the wildlife. The history of each of Sevilles bridges was fascinating and it was interesting to see the most beautiful and historical buildings from the river. I would thoroughly recommend this trip, it was excellent value for money.
author: Barbara_A

title: Favourite tour with our favourite guide!
text: We went on five tours when we were in Seville and this was our favourite with our favourite guide. Caesar was fun and knowledgeable and you can tell he is so passionate about the river. He effortlessly switched between languages for the different nationalities of the tour - making sure everyone understood and felt included. The tour was also great value for money considering how relaxing and fun we found it. 10/10 you should promote Caesar ⭐️
author: Helen_S

title: Worthwhile and fun tour!
text: Caesar was extremely knowledgeable, interesting and funny.  In 90 minutes, we learned about a rich history that we did not know. Highly recommend this tour!
author: Grace_B

title: Relaxing informal very...
text: Relaxing informal very helpful friendly great tour guy . We loved it . Definitely would recommend the tour
author: Pauline_A

title: Excellent guide and trip
text: It is good to have a small group and our captain Cesar managed to talk for the whole trip keeping us entertained and informed. We would certainly recommend this trip for a relaxing way to learn about Cesar’s history of Seville!
author: scisaacs

title: Small personal experience
text: What an amazing little tour. So firstly expected it to be one of those ghastly large boats with no real personal feeling but to our surprise we were on a small boat, similar to what a lot would describe as a speed boat. In total there were 6 of us on board. Great information as we toured for a fully hour and half…. A little bonus was the free drink which I hadn’t noticed about when booking!
author: Andrew_C

title: Excellent, small boat, so...
text: Excellent, small boat, so personal experience. Captain was friendly and knowledgeable. Good way to see riverside Seville!
author: Stephen_C

title: Fabulous
text: Unforgettable boat trip on Los Rincones del Guadalquivir! Stunning river views, fascinating history and beautiful Seville from the water. Smooth ride, great guide – pure magic! Highly recommend!
author: gellur

title: Great activity!
text: I did not have much expectation being a cheap activity but it ended being great. The captain (I think his name was José) gave us lots of information and it was really pleasant being on the canal and looking at the sights of interests from that point of view. It was super chill, highly recommended after 2h30 tour of the Alcazar. Would recommend it.
author: Laurent_C

title: Best way to see the city from the river
text: The stories told by the captain both entertained and informed. His love for Seville really came across and made you want to love it also. It was seamless getting on the boat and a cold beer was a welcome treat. The small group size really was a bonus when you saw the large boats filled with people, there is no way they would have had the experience the 12 of us had. We were given the option of being dropped off in Triana which was perfect for us to go and eat.
author: TamworthPaul
